translations.web: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.
translations.bsb: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and splatter it on all sides of the altar.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
translations.asv: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take its blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
